messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — found production panic when serving long prompts on v1.12.1. I opened a hotfix branch and a tiny patch. Patch bump target: v1.12.2. Need expedited cutover within the hour.
Priya S: Can you drop the failing stack trace and the commit SHA? I'll triage.
Alex W: stack:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 42 [running]:
...
```
commit: 9f3b4c7 (small guard in runtime/kv_cache.go)
Alex W: PR -> https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/4592 — it's a 3-line change, unit tests pass locally.
Michael T: 3-line change sounds good. Any migrations? Can we keep minimal diffs? :eyes: 
Alex W: no migrations. no schema changes. just nil check and a test. I tagged it 'hotfix/minimal'
Samir: dropping an LGTM in PR, will run the smoke suite on staging. ETA ~20m.
Jen L: Quick reminder — please add a single-line changelog entry under unreleased: "v1.12.2: runtime: fix nil deref in kv cache (hotfix)". Keep concise.
Priya S: cutoff reminder — release window is 45m from now per schedule. If we miss, we wait for next slot.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULE NOTICE: Hotfix cutoff in 45 minutes for release branch release/v1.12. Proceed with cherry-picks and canary config.
Alex W: plan: cherry-pick 9f3b4c7 -> release/v1.12, open hotfix release PR, set canary = 10% for 15m, monitor latency/5xx. rollback plan = revert cherry-pick + restart canary pool.
Michael T: I'll watch telemetry. If errors go up >0.5% switch rollback. Will notify #incidents.
Samir: smoke passed on staging. pushing cherry-pick now:
`git checkout release/v1.12 && git cherry-pick 9f3b4c7 && git push origin release/v1.12` :white_check_mark:
Alex W: thx. tagging @oncall for deploy window: @maria-oncall can you ack the canary deploy?
Maria Oncall: Acked. I'll be online for the next 40m. :+1: 
Jen L: changelog updated in the PR description. small note: add 'fixes: #4721' if you want issue traceability.
Alex W: added issue ref. PR now 4592-hotfix -> reviewer: @michael. requesting fast-track merge after green canary.
Michael T: Reviewing now. Two nits but nothing blocking. :shipit: 
deploy-bot: DEPLOY: Canary deploy started for release/v1.12 @ 10% traffic.
Alex W: monitoring. thanks all. will post final when fully rolled.
Michael T: Canary healthy at 15m. promoting to 100% in 5.
deploy-bot: DEPLOY: Promotion complete. release/v1.12 updated to include 9f3b4c7. :tada: 
Alex W: release done. changelog published, backports noted. cheers :party_parrot: 
Priya S: closing the thread — please ping if any regressions.
